Default Prove-Up.
MINI MINUTES: Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: Carla Amador & Sajja Ravinantapricha , CSR: Maureen Howard #7156 (Department 218)

Appearances
Plaintiff, Lloyd Frisbie, is not present.
Attorney, James P. Nevin, is present on behalf of the plaintiff.

Defendant, Patterson Parts, is not present.
(Default was entered on 10/4/07 as to the defendant)

This cause came on calendar this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing. On December 4, 2007, the Court granted plaintiff's request to waive the appearance of the plaintiff. Counsel testifies via offer of proof.

After hearing the testimony and considering of the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant, Patterson Parts, as follows:

Defendant shall pay plaintiff, as and for interest, the sum of $513.70, cost in the sum of $335.00 and service fee in the sum of $20.00 for a total Judgment of $868.70. Plaintiff's counsel to submit a proposed judgment to the Court.
